battle.name: 石子河之戰
battle.brief: 大業十三年（617）十一月，劉武周部將宋金剛進圍太原（晉陽），李淵在關中初定，命李世民率精騎數千星夜馳援。世民自龍門濟河，於汾河中游石子河迎戰宋金剛出騎，斬首數千級、俘精兵萬餘人，太原之圍遂解。卡面的羅馬投石機（onager）不在此役現場，卻是隋末唐初攻城器械的骨幹。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 大業十三年（617）秋冬，關中與河東同時開戰。一方是關中新建的唐軍：唐國公李淵自太原起兵，兵入關中，十一月克長安，隨後奉隋恭帝即位、建立唐朝；關中以長安、涇渭與河套為後方，兵員糧秣靠關中倉儲與黃河漕運供應，山西方向的指揮權交給秦王李世民，唐軍以輕騎自關中沿河東下，目標是保住太原與河東。另一方是起兵於馬邑的劉武周與其盟友。劉武周依託東突厥始畢可汗的支持，率本地郡兵與馬邑舊部東進，先取介休，再以宋金剛為前鋒大舉進攻晉陽（太原），圍城待援，把河東的門戶完全打開；其部眾中雜有數千突厥突騎，步卒則多為河東鄉兵與歸附的隋軍殘部。第三方並非旁觀：竇建德在河北建夏國、王世充在洛陽另立鄭政權，兩方都無力再對唐發動大規模進攻，等於替唐解除了北面以外的牽制；東突厥則在劉武周與唐之間反覆下注，既助兵助馬，又因唐使張士貴的賂遣而逐步收手。整場戰爭因此是唐、劉武周—突厥聯盟與北方群雄三方在河東一線的角力。
countriesEn: In the autumn and winter of Daye 13 (617) war broke out at the same time in Guanzhong and in Hedong. On one side stood the new Tang army: Duke of Tang Li Yuan had risen in arms at Taiyuan, marched into Guanzhong, carried Chang'an in the eleventh month, and then installed the puppet Emperor Gong of Sui and proclaimed the Tang. Guanzhong, with Chang'an, the Wei and Jing valleys and the Heluo stores behind it, supplied the troops and the grain, the heavy baggage moving on the river routes of the Yellow River, while the direction of operations in Shanxi was handed to the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin; the Tang column came down from Guanzhong as light cavalry with one purpose in view, to hold Taiyuan and Hedong. On the other side stood Liu Wuzhou of Mayi and his allies. Liu Wuzhou, leaning on the support of the Eastern Turkic qaghan Shibie, led the local militia and the old soldiers of his rising eastward, taking Jiexiu first and then driving on Jinyang (Taiyuan) with Song Jingang as his assault commander; he sat down before the city waiting for his own reinforcements and thereby opened the gate of Hedong wide. Several thousand Turkic horse were mixed into his ranks, while his foot soldiers were largely Hedong village levies and Sui army remnants that had come over. The other parties were not bystanders: Dou Jiande had founded the Xia state in Hebei and Wang Shichong had set up a Zheng regime at Luoyang, and neither was strong enough to launch a large offensive against the Tang, which relieved the Tang of every pressure except the northern one. The Eastern Turks, meanwhile, kept betting alternately on Liu Wuzhou and on the Tang, sending cavalry and horses, then drawing back after the Tang envoy Zhang Shigui bribed them. The whole war was therefore a three-cornered contest along the Hedong front between the Tang, the Liu Wuzhou-Turkic alliance, and the northern warlords.
people: 唐軍方面，決定這場戰役走向的是李世民。他自太原起兵時即以少壯精騎隨軍，至此不過十九歲上下；史載他奉命之後不待大軍集齊，率精騎數千星夜兼程，十餘日而至太原前沿，選擇在石子河一線迎住宋金剛。作戰前他不肯分兵去攻壘壁，只把騎兵收攏成一團，專打宋金剛的鋒芒；破敵之後不給對手重整的時間，連夜追擊到介休一帶再破一陣，最終把太原之圍解開。他身邊另有數名關鍵人物。平陽公主的丈夫柴紹自太原起兵時便與之同行，是最早跟著李淵、世民入關的老將之一；部將劉弘基善騎射，隨軍轉戰河東；段志玄與張公謹在攻守轉換中出力，張公謹更獻策主張乘勝追擊，反對在介休城下曠日持久。李淵本人則在關中主持大局，下詔令世民馳援太原，另遣張士貴攜財物出使東突厥，離間始畢可汗與劉武周的盟約，這一手外交，使劉武周失去最大的外援。敵方人馬以劉武周與宋金剛為核心。劉武周是馬邑出身的郡兵首領，起事後殺官略地，把晉陽當作進取關中的跳板；宋金剛是他最倚重的名將，驍勇善戰，屢次在前線與唐騎硬碰。始畢可汗在幕後提供突騎與戰馬，又因收受賄賂而延遲出兵，劉武周的崩潰正由此開始。
peopleEn: On the Tang side the man who decided the shape of this campaign was Li Shimin. He had ridden with the young cavalry from the rising at Taiyuan, and he was now only about nineteen years old. According to the histories, once the order reached him he did not wait for the main army to assemble: he took several thousand picked horsemen, rode night and day, and reached the front of Taiyuan within some ten days, choosing to meet Song Jingang on the Shizi River. Before the engagement he refused to detach troops to grind at the fortified positions, drawing his horse into a single mass aimed at the point of Song Jingang's advance; and once the enemy was broken he gave him no time to reform, pursuing by night as far as the Jiexiu area and breaking him a second time, so that the siege of Taiyuan was finally lifted. Several other men mattered around him. Chai Shao, husband of Princess Pingyang, had ridden with Li Yuan and Li Shimin from the rising at Taiyuan and was one of the oldest of the officers who marched into Guanzhong; the officer Liu Hongji was a noted horseman who campaigned with him through Hedong; Duan Zhixuan and Zhang Gongjin carried the fighting once the campaign turned from manoeuvre to siege, and it was Zhang Gongjin who urged the forward pursuit instead of a long siege before Jiexiu. Li Yuan himself held things together in Guanzhong: he ordered Li Shimin's relief of Taiyuan, and separately sent Zhang Shigui to the Eastern Turks with gifts and money to drive a wedge between Shibie qaghan and Liu Wuzhou, a piece of diplomacy that stripped Liu Wuzhou of his strongest support. The enemy was centred on Liu Wuzhou and Song Jingang. Liu Wuzhou was a militia commander from Mayi who killed the local officials and rose, treating Jinyang as a springboard for a march on Guanzhong. Song Jingang was the commander he depended on, dashing and skilled in the field, and he met Li Shimin's cavalry head on more than once. Behind them Shibie qaghan supplied Turkic horsemen and remounts, and then, having taken the Tang bribes, delayed his intervention; that delay is where the collapse of Liu Wuzhou began.
kits: 卡面這具投石機是羅馬的 onager：以扭力絞盤儲存能量，靠一副長臂把石彈拋出，是此前數百年攻城技術的骨幹，也是「投射式攻城器械」這一門類的代表。羅馬人用它對付高城，最大射程可以達到百米上下，真正能砸中城堞、塔樓的射界則在數十米之內；同一門類的機器在中國與地中海兩套技術譜系中都存在，動力原理卻不同——漢唐的拋石車以車架、槓桿與繩索牽引發射，靠人力與配重相配合，拋得更高更平，隋末唐初人稱之為砲車、飛石。石子河一役本身是野戰與追擊，拋石類器械並沒有出現在河谷的戰場上；它們真正的位置在這場戰爭的兩端：劉武周圍攻太原，靠的是雲梯、撞車與拋石車一類的攻具把外城逼到極限，而唐軍在介休、柏壁一線的反攻攻城，同樣以投射器械打頭陣，用以摧毀城堞、屋舍與集結中的守軍。同期兩軍的裝備骨架則是馬匹與弩。世民的精騎是唐軍的精華，人馬皆備甲胄，佩刀、馬槊、騎槍與角弓同時攜帶，步卒以標槍、方盾和冷兵器列陣；劉武周部的突厥突騎更重騎射與奔衝，步卒則多倚賴雲梯、撞車等器械攻城。唐軍的糧秣以牛車與黃河船運從關中、蒲坂方向接濟，箭矢與甲械在長安、汾州一線的倉儲中補充，投石車一類的重型器械則隨軍需車載行走，靠前面壘壁先立陣而後展開。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman onager: a machine that stores energy in a torsion frame and throws a stone bolt from a long arm, the backbone of siegecraft for the centuries before and the archetype of the projectile siege engine. The Romans used it against high walls; its maximum range was on the order of a hundred metres, while the range at which it actually struck parapets and towers lay within a few dozen metres. The same class of machine appears in both the Roman and the Chinese technical tradition, but the power principle differs: the Chinese stone-thrower of the Sui and Tang worked from a wheeled frame, a lever and traction ropes, combining muscle power with a counterweight, and flew flatter and further. Sui and Tang men called it a paoche, a feishi, or a paopao cart. The battle of the Shizi River was in truth a field action and a pursuit, and no projectile engine stood in the river valley itself. Their true place in this war is at the two ends of it: Liu Wuzhou's siege of Taiyuan leaned on scaling ladders, battering rams and stone-throwers to press the outer defences to their limit, and the Tang counter-offensive at Jiexiu and Bai Bi likewise opened with projectile fire aimed at parapets, at buildings, and at the defenders massing behind the wall. The equipment skeleton of both armies was the horse and the crossbow. Li Shimin's picked cavalry was the core of the Tang force, men and horses both armoured, carrying sabre, horse lance, cavalry lance and composite bow; the foot soldiers formed up with javelins, shields and cold weapons, while the Turkic horse of Liu Wuzhou's army weighted riding, archery and the charge. The Tang drew grain and equipment by ox-cart and by river boat from Guanzhong and Puban, replenishing arrows and armour from the stores of Chang'an and Fenzhou, while the heavy engines travelled on baggage wagons and were emplaced only after the forward earthworks had been thrown up.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術主軸，是「以城制援」與「以騎制城」兩種思路的對撞。劉武周、宋金剛不急著直趨關中，先取介休、進圍晉陽，企圖以太原這座北方重鎮為支點：城是餌，城外是獵場，一旦唐軍來救，就在野地裡吃掉援軍。太原城高池深，短期難破，唐軍的選擇只有兩條路，一是放棄北方，二是用最快速度帶一支能打的騎兵插到河東。李世民選了後者。他不帶攻城器械，不打攻城戰，也不分兵去碰城池，全軍收攏為一支數千人的精騎，晝夜兼程趕在宋金剛之前抵達石子河。河谷狹長、兩岸有堤，騎兵一旦展開便難以迴旋，世民選擇在宋金剛騎隊進入谷地時集中突擊，用速度與縱深換取正面交鋒的機會；破敵之後立刻轉入追擊，連續作戰，不讓宋金剛收攏散兵重整。隨後的攻守完全翻轉。唐軍不急於強攻介休，改以柏壁為營，長久圍困，切斷劉武周自突厥與河東鄉村補給的通道，用饑餓而不是撞車與雲梯去消耗對手；劉武周放棄太原，節節退守，最終只能率殘部北走突厥，被突厥擒獲送回，為唐軍所斬。外交上，李淵一面遣使賂突厥，一面用「以食逼敵」拖垮對手，兩手同時進行，構成本役完整的戰略骨架。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of this war was the collision of two doctrines: using the city to control the relief, and using cavalry to defeat the besieged. Liu Wuzhou and Song Jingang did not hurry towards Guanzhong; they took Jiexiu, closed around Jinyang, and tried to make Taiyuan a fulcrum, the city serving as bait and the open ground beyond as the killing ground, so that a Tang relief army would be destroyed in the field. Taiyuan was too strongly built to be taken quickly, and the Tang had only two options: abandon the north, or move a usable body of horse at the fastest possible speed into Hedong. Li Shimin chose the second. He brought no siege engines, fought no siege, and detached no troops to go after towns; the whole force was closed up into some thousands of picked horsemen who rode day and night to reach the Shizi River ahead of Song Jingang. The valley is narrow and its banks offer cover, and once cavalry are committed there they cannot turn, so Li Shimin chose to strike in concentration when Song Jingang's riders entered the ground, buying the chance of a set-piece action with speed and depth. The moment the enemy broke, the action became a pursuit carried on without pause, so that Song Jingang could never gather his scattered riders. Afterwards the pattern inverted entirely. The Tang did not press the assault on Jiexiu; they camped at Bai Bi, surrounded the place for a long time, and cut the supply lines by which Liu Wuzhou drew provisions from the Turks and from the villages of Hedong, wearing the enemy down with hunger rather than with rams and ladders. Liu Wuzhou abandoned Taiyuan, fell back step by step, and finally could only take the remnant of his army north to the Turks, where he was seized and handed back to be executed by the Tang. In diplomacy, Li Yuan sent envoys to bribe the Turks while the field army starved the enemy; those two moves together form the complete strategic frame of the campaign.
data: 時間線可以排得比較清楚：大業十三年（617）秋，劉武周攻陷介休、進圍晉陽，沿河郡兵節節退保，太原告急；同年十一月，李世民率精騎至石子河破宋金剛，太原之圍解；同月李淵攻克長安，十二月隋恭帝遜位，唐朝建立。次年武德三年（620），李世民進軍柏壁合圍劉武周，斷其糧道，迫其北走突厥被擒，山西悉平。兵力方面，兩《唐書》記世民所將為「精騎數千」，劉武周、宋金剛一方的騎兵中混有突厥突騎數千，步騎合計當在數萬之數；石子河一役的戰果，舊、新《唐書》均記「斬首數千級，俘其精兵萬餘人」，部將郜定山等相率來降（各家於個別人名與數目略有出入，不必拘泥）。行程方面，從龍門渡汾至太原的道路約五六百里，輕騎急行，舊史有「旬日而至」與「數日而至」兩說。地理是這一戰的關鍵：石子河是汾河中游的支流，位於今山西洪洞、霍州一帶，谷道狹長、兩岸可設伏，兩軍一旦在谷中接觸，騎兵無法展開，勝負只在幾個小時內決定。器械方面，羅馬 onager 的最大射程古代記載約在百米上下，實際作戰多在數十米內生效；中國拋石車的有效射程也在百米上下，攻城時通常列在距城牆數百步的位置，覆蓋城堞與牆後的建築群，發射須成排成列地反覆打擊同一段城牆。
dataEn: The chronology can be set out fairly clearly. In the autumn of Daye 13 (617) Liu Wuzhou carried Jiexiu and closed on Jinyang, the local Sui forces falling back step by step, and Taiyuan sent up urgent appeals for help. In the eleventh month of the same year Li Shimin reached the Shizi River, defeated Song Jingang and relieved the city; in that same month Li Yuan carried Chang'an, and in the twelfth month Emperor Gong of Sui abdicated and the Tang was founded. In the following year, Wude 3 (620), Li Shimin advanced to Bai Bi, closed around Liu Wuzhou, cut his supplies and forced him north to the Turks, where he was seized, and Shanxi was wholly pacified. As for numbers, the two Tang histories describe the force Li Shimin led as 'several thousand picked horsemen'; Liu Wuzhou and Song Jingang fielded some thousands of Turkic horse among their cavalry, with foot and horse together numbering in the tens of thousands. The result at the Shizi River is given in both the Old and the New Tang histories as 'several thousand heads cut off and more than ten thousand of the elite captured', with officers such as Gao Dingshan coming over to surrender; the individual names and figures differ a little between sources and there is no need to press the point. As for distance, the road from Longmen across the Fen to Taiyuan runs some five or six hundred li, and the light cavalry rode it hard; the old histories variously say the column arrived within ten days or within a few. Geography decided the engagement: the Shizi River is a tributary of the middle Fen, in what is now the Hongtong and Huozhou area of Shanxi, its valley long and narrow, its banks suited to ambush, and once the two sides engaged inside it the cavalry could not deploy, so that the outcome was settled within a few hours. As for engines, the maximum range of the Roman onager is given in ancient sources at around a hundred metres, though in practice it took effect within a few dozen; the Chinese stone-thrower of this period had an effective range of the same order, and in siege was normally emplaced several hundred paces from the wall, covering the parapets and the buildings behind them, firing in repeated salvos against the same stretch of wall.
cause: 起義的直接源頭是隋末的崩解。煬帝連年征高句麗，徭役、兵役、輸積壓在山東河北，饑疫並作，盜賊遍起；大業十年之後，郡縣吏民紛紛據城自立，隋朝在名義上還有天子，實際上已無力控制州郡。馬邑郡兵首領劉武周見有機可乘，殺掉本地官吏聚眾起事，先據馬邑、雁門，隨後把目光投向富庶的河東。他與唐室的對抗則由戰略位置決定。劉武周若能拿下晉陽（太原），就等於拔掉唐朝的北方根基，扼住關中的門戶；反過來，唐朝剛剛在關中立足，北方一旦被劉武周與突厥聯軍控制，李淵的集團就退無可退。因此太原必須救，救太原的任務只能交給李世民——李淵本人與關中剛剛接管的京城、倉儲、兵員都抽不開。外部形勢同樣推著唐軍必須速戰。李淵的關中四面受敵：河北有竇建德的夏國，關東有王世充的鄭軍，朔方夏州一線有梁師都的叛軍，涼州方向還有吐谷渾與黨項的牽制；劉武周則早與東突厥始畢可汗結盟，得助兵馬，甚至約定合擊太原。於是雙方都在搶時間：劉武周要在唐軍完成整合之前把太原變成囊中之物，唐軍則要在劉武周合圍之前把援軍送到、把他擋在晉陽之外。
causeEn: The immediate origin of the rising lay in the collapse of the Sui. The Yangdi's repeated campaigns against Goguryeo piled forced labour, conscription and grain transport onto the eastern provinces, famine and epidemic followed, and bandits rose everywhere; after the tenth year of Daye the officials of commanderies and counties began holding their cities on their own, so that the Sui still had an emperor in name but no longer controlled its provinces. Liu Wuzhou, a militia officer of Mayi, saw the opening, killed the local officials, raised a mass of followers, first securing Mayi and Yanmen, and then turned his eyes on the wealthy Hedong. His confrontation with the Tang was settled by geography. If Liu Wuzhou could take Jinyang (Taiyuan) he would cut away the northern foundation of the Tang and hold the gateway of Guanzhong; conversely, with the Tang newly established in Guanzhong, if the north fell to Liu Wuzhou and the Turks, Li Yuan's group would have nowhere to retreat. Taiyuan therefore had to be held, and the task of relieving it could only be given to Li Shimin, since Li Yuan himself and the newly taken capital, its stores and its manpower were all tied down in Guanzhong. The wider situation pushed the Tang towards quick decision just as much. Li Yuan was surrounded on all sides: Xia under Dou Jiande in Hebei, Zheng under Wang Shichong east of the passes, the revolt of Liang Shidu along the Shuofang and Bingzhou lines, and pressure from the Tuyuhun and the Dangxiang towards Liangzhou. Liu Wuzhou, for his part, had long since allied with the Eastern Turkic qaghan Shibie, who sent troops and horses and even agreed to strike at Taiyuan together. Both sides were therefore racing against time: Liu Wuzhou wanted Taiyuan sealed up before the Tang finished reorganising, and the Tang wanted a relief force on the spot before the net closed.
impact: 短期看，這一戰保住了唐朝的北方基地。劉武周集團覆亡之後，河東歸唐，唐朝得以把兵力轉向關東：先在洛陽與王世充相持，隨後滅竇建德之夏、平定江南，完成了中原與南方主要割據勢力的掃除。世民本人也因這一戰聲名大振，收編郜定山等降將、擴充自己的部眾與兵權，十九歲的秦王在關中軍府中的份量由此改變；正因這一階段累積的兵權與威望，後來玄武門之變時父子君臣之間的猜忌並非憑空而來。與北方的關係也從此改寫。劉武周一死，東突厥始畢可汗與唐恢復往來，翌年互市重新開啟；但頗利可汗在唐立國後立刻南下攻唐，太原與河東反而成了唐的邊防前線，東突厥問題一直拖到貞觀初年才被解決。唐初的府兵體制、以騎兵為核心的野戰能力，以及石子河一役所展示的「不攻城、專打援」的野戰思路，都在這幾年裡被反覆使用，成為唐軍對付北方遊牧騎兵的基本套路。技術層面上，隋末唐初的攻城仍以拋石車、雲梯、撞車為骨幹，而唐軍在介休、柏壁一線用圍斷糧道代替強攻，反映出一個趨勢：當投射攻城器械已經能決定城牆命運時，進攻方必須付出遠高於守方的時間與器材代價，因而更傾向於運動戰與斷糧。
impactEn: In the short term the battle saved the northern base of the new dynasty. With the collapse of Liu Wuzhou's group, Hedong returned to Tang control, and the Tang could turn its forces eastward: first holding Wang Shichong at Luoyang, then destroying Dou Jiande's Xia and pacifying the south, which completed the reduction of the principal separatist powers of the centre and the south. Li Shimin himself came out of it famous, taking over surrendered officers such as Gao Dingshan and enlarging his own command and his military authority; the standing the nineteen-year-old Prince of Qin enjoyed in the Guanzhong war council was changed by what he had done, and it was precisely the troops and prestige accumulated in this phase that lay behind the mistrust between father and son which later produced the Xuanwu Gate incident. Relations with the north were rewritten as well. With Liu Wuzhou dead, the Eastern Turkic qaghan Shibie resumed contact with the Tang and the border trade was reopened the following year; but Shibie's successor, the qaghan Jieli, struck south into Tang territory as soon as the dynasty was founded, so that Taiyuan and Hedong became the Tang's frontier, and the Eastern Turkic question was not settled until the early Zhenguan years. The Tang's fubing system, its ability to fight a war of manoeuvre with cavalry as the core, and the doctrine demonstrated at the Shizi River - do not attack the city, strike the relief - were all used again and again in the years that followed, becoming the standard Tang answer to the mounted raiders of the steppe. At the level of technique, Sui-Tang siegecraft still rested on the stone-thrower, the scaling ladder and the battering ram, and the Tang habit of cutting supply lines instead of storming walls at Jiexiu and Bai Bi reflects a general trend: once projectile siege engines could decide the fate of a wall, the attacker had to pay a price in time and materials far above what the defender paid, which pushed armies back towards manoeuvre and famine.
result: 石子河一役的直接結果是唐軍完勝：李世民的精騎在河谷中擊潰宋金剛的出騎，斬首數千級、俘獲精兵萬餘人，郜定山等將校相率歸降，太原之圍當夜而解，宋金剛所部的進攻能力被從中折斷。但石子河只是劉武周集團敗亡的第一環。唐軍乘勝追擊至介休再破其眾，隨後改採柏壁長圍，斷糧逼迫；劉武周放棄太原，節節北退，最終率殘部投奔東突厥，旋被突厥擒獲送回，於武德三年為唐軍所斬，河北的竇建德與關中的梁師都先後覆滅，隋末北方最大的一支割據勢力就此瓦解。從長遠看，劉武周的敗亡把唐朝從關中一隅的割據者，推成了能夠號令中原的王朝；李世民則以這場戰役為踏板，鍛鍊出一支能打、能追、能斷糧的騎兵主力，日後的唐滅夏、破鄭、平天下，多沿用此役確立的辦法。至於拋石機這一類投射式攻城器械，它在石子河的河谷裡沒有出場，卻始終站在這場戰爭的幕後：它決定了城牆的攻防比，逼迫交戰雙方都把機動與補給放在純粹的攻城技術之前。
resultEn: The direct outcome at the Shizi River was a clear Tang victory: Li Shimin's cavalry broke Song Jingang's sortie in the valley, cutting off several thousand and taking more than ten thousand prisoners, officers such as Gao Dingshan surrendering, and the siege of Taiyuan lifted the same night. The middle of Song Jingang's offensive power was snapped in two. But the Shizi River was only the first link in Liu Wuzhou's undoing. The Tang pursued to Jiexiu and broke his forces again, then switched to the long blockade at Bai Bi and cut his supplies; Liu Wuzhou abandoned Taiyuan, fell back step by step, and finally took the remnant of his army to the Eastern Turks, only to be seized there and handed back, to be executed by the Tang in Wude 3, while Dou Jiande in Hebei and Liang Shidu in Guanzhong were destroyed in turn; the largest separatist force of the late Sui in the north came apart in this way. In the long run the death of Liu Wuzhou turned the Tang from a separatist regime in one corner of Guanzhong into a dynasty able to command the central plain. Li Shimin used the battle as a step to forge a cavalry force that could fight, could pursue and could cut supplies, and the later Tang campaigns against Xia, against Zheng and against the rest of the realm largely followed the methods established here. As for the projectile siege engine represented by the card's onager, it never appeared in the valley of the Shizi River, yet it stood behind the curtain throughout this war: it set the ratio of attack to defence at the wall, and it forced both sides to put manoeuvre and supply ahead of pure siege technique.
